  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  January 22, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:43 a.m.

  Members Present: Kathy Ares, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Marie E. Heaney, Finance Manager

  Staff Present:  Ismael Perez, Water Treatment Plant Supervisor

1. The minutes of January 14, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.
2. Kazarians and Associates, Inc. – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommended settlement payment of $6,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:45 a.m.

Adjournment
